summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload at install time
details: @ornikar/eslint-config-typescript-react@24.0.5 is published as an ESLint configuration but ships a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) whose contents are identifier-obfuscated (hex-named variables, shuffled string-array indirection). On `npm install`, setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime archive from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, extracts the `bun` binary to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and runs the sibling file `math_init.js` with it via `execFileSync`. math_init.js is a 727KB obfuscated script (rotated string array loader in the style of obfuscator.io) that has no relationship to ESLint configuration. Fetching an alternate runtime and executing a large opaque payload at install time is unrelated to the package's stated purpose and constitutes install-time remote code execution against every machine that installs the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
